Mr. Yogesh Upadhyay, Advocate for the 
appellant.
2. This is an appeal under Section 19 of Family 
Courts Act, challenging judgment dated 26.05.2025, 
rendered by learned Additional Principal Judge, 
Family Court, Kashipur, District Udham Singh Nagar 
in Family Case No. 390 of 2019. 
3. By the said judgment, learned Court below 
gave a declaration in favour of respondent that his 
marriage with the appellant has been dissolved as 
per Muslim law.
4. Issue notice to respondent returnable within 
four weeks. Steps be taken within a week.
5. List on 15.09.2025.
6. Till next date of listing, effect and operation of 
impugned judgment dated 26.05.2025 shall remain 
stayed.
7. Stay Application (IA/1/2025) stands disposed 
of.
(Subhash Upadhyay, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.)
 02.07.2025 Mahinder/
